items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: No. I think I met him once or twice. Because he was a busy man.

ctx.x: I think he was in New York by that time. He had a little difficulty... And quite there was quite a few drummers, some White boys, who wanted to play like him. But Baby Dodds had his own thing going, his own style, you know. He'd play on the rim of the drums and press rolls; he'd do a lot of press-rolling on the snare drum. You'd not hear too much cymbal work.
Well, you mentioned in our last session (and this is going back a bit) that in Detroit at the Graystone Ballroom, there was also the Jean Goldkette Band. Do you
remember any of the guys from that band? Do you remember Chauncey Morehouse?
